scope: Reusable internal assets evaluated for the Stratum Praxis Systems Library MVP.
method: Every row was checked against the repository at commit b9ffb48 on branch claude/stratum-systems-library-mvp-1jzxit. Test states were produced by running the suites, not read from documentation. Live URL states could not be produced from this session: outbound HTTPS to stratumpraxis.com, gumroad.com and payhip.com is refused by the network egress policy (403 on CONNECT), so every live claim below is marked NOT_VERIFIED_FROM_THIS_SESSION and is deferred to the GitHub Actions HTTP verifier that runs with egress.
license_constraint: The repository root LICENSE is MIT and the repository is public. Every file in it is already MIT-licensed to the world. No asset extracted from it can honestly be sold under a restrictive PERSONAL/COMMERCIAL/AGENCY licence, because the published versions are already permissively licensed. This constraint decided the disposition of every code asset below and is the single largest open decision for the owner.

assets.name: First-person truth gate / fabricated-biography gate / privacy gate
assets.current_brand: Stratum Praxis (internal, unpublished as a product)
assets.intended_user: Anyone running an automated or semi-automated content pipeline that writes in the first person.
assets.problem_solved: An LLM writing as a named person invents testing, purchases, clients, credentials and biography. Nothing in a normal content stack catches it.
assets.documentation_state: Inline comments only; no user-facing README before this work.
assets.secret_exposure_risk: LOW - no credentials in the module. identity.json contains the operator's public positioning and a contact allowlist, which is business data, not a secret.
assets.production_data_exposure_risk: MEDIUM - identity.json encodes the real operator's approved/prohibited claims and cites revenue-os/metrics.json. Must be replaced by a placeholder contract in any package.
assets.clean_room_extraction_effort: LOW - two files, one internal dependency, four brand-specific values to move into the contract.
assets.license_feasibility: MIT only. Source is already public and MIT-licensed; a restrictive licence cannot be applied retroactively.
assets.evidence_of_current_operation: 80 passing tests executed in this session. The module is imported by acquisition/media-engine/lib/derive.mjs in the publishing path.
assets.demand_evidence: NONE - no search, sales or enquiry evidence for this specific product was found in the repository. Selection was made on extraction safety and problem clarity, not on measured demand.

assets.name: Duplicate and cannibalization guard
assets.intended_user: Content-ops, SEO and newsletter operators running multi-channel or multi-language pipelines.
assets.problem_solved: A pipeline produces near-duplicates that split its own traffic and repeat to the same audience. Translation and reshuffling both read as 'new' to a human reviewer.
assets.documentation_state: Inline comments only before this work.
assets.test_state: VERIFIED - acquisition/media-engine/test/duplication.test.mjs is part of the 80 passing media-engine tests.
assets.secret_exposure_risk: NONE - pure functions over supplied text.
assets.production_data_exposure_risk: LOW - no production data in the module; the coupling is to a routing file, not to content.
assets.clean_room_extraction_effort: MEDIUM - three internal dependencies had to be reduced to a self-contained text primitive module.
assets.license_feasibility: MIT only, same constraint as truth-gate.
assets.evidence_of_current_operation: Passing tests executed in this session; imported by the media-engine derivation path.

assets.name: UTM attribution contract
assets.intended_user: Solo operators and small teams who own both their links and their analytics.
assets.problem_solved: Campaign tags drift into several spellings, CTAs ship untagged, and funnels report conversion rates over stages that were never measured.
assets.documentation_state: Inline comments only before this work.
assets.production_data_exposure_risk: MEDIUM in the original - taxonomy.mjs contains the live analytics event vocabulary and approved destination domains. Both were dropped or genericised in the package.
assets.clean_room_extraction_effort: MEDIUM - the routing table, owned domains and checkout hosts had to become inputs rather than fixed repository paths.
assets.evidence_of_current_operation: 63 passing tests executed in this session; used by acquisition/cli/route.mjs and the queue/safety gates.

assets.name: Publisher authorization gate
assets.intended_user: Teams automating publishing who need an account-authorization boundary.
assets.problem_solved: Prevents an automated pipeline from publishing through an unauthorized channel or provider.
reusable_components: lane classification: AUTO_PUBLISH_ALLOWED / HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED / HUMAN_PUBLISH_REQUIRED / BLOCKED
assets.test_state: VERIFIED - covered by the 80 passing media-engine tests.
assets.production_data_exposure_risk: HIGH - the module reads four repository-specific policy files that encode which providers and accounts this business has actually connected. Extracting it means rebuilding that policy model generically.
assets.defer_reason: Four-file policy coupling makes the clean-room cost high and the resulting product hard to explain without the surrounding engine. Revisit only if the first three packages show traffic.

assets.name: Acquisition Signal Intelligence starter
assets.intended_user: Operators triaging demand signals into asset routing decisions.
assets.problem_solved: Turns scattered demand evidence into a corroborated, scored candidate bound to an existing asset.
assets.production_data_exposure_risk: HIGH - the scoring only means anything against this business's real asset inventory, which lists live products, prices and revenue destinations.
assets.defer_reason: The system is genuinely good but it is inseparable from a populated asset inventory. Shipping it as a package would ship an empty scoring engine with no way to demonstrate value.

assets.name: Revenue Publisher (owned-media autonomous blogger)
assets.intended_user: Operators running an owned-media publishing loop.
assets.problem_solved: Generates and publishes evidence-grounded owned media without a paid API.
assets.test_state: NOT_VERIFIED - no test suite for acquisition/blogger/.
assets.secret_exposure_risk: MEDIUM - the runners require third-party API credentials. None are committed, but any package must ship an .env.example and a hard credential boundary.
assets.production_data_exposure_risk: HIGH - state.json and the outbox contain this business's actual publishing history.
assets.evidence_of_current_operation: Two generated articles committed on this branch on 2026-08-29; last-run diagnostics captured. Live URL state NOT_VERIFIED_FROM_THIS_SESSION.
assets.review_reason: Selling a publisher that calls a third-party AI API makes the buyer's cost and terms-of-service position the seller's problem. That is a commercial and support decision the owner must make, not a packaging decision.
